'''Pyther''' was [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Balmorran resistance]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. His [[Pyther's mother|mother]] and [[Pyther's father|father]] both died when the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] abandoned the planet and led the Empire take over, prompting him to join the resistance cell led by [[Gray Star]]. By [[3643 BBY]] he was part of the group led by [[Chemish Or]], which cooperated with the [[Eagle's network]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pyther is a non-player character from the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He is voiced by [[Nolan North]].
